Class TurSNGenAi

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.TurSNGenAi
@Component public class TurSNGenAi extends Object
RAG service for Semantic Navigation sites. Handles document indexing into embedding store and RAG-based chat responses.

    • assistantConversationStreaming

      public reactor.core.publisher.Flux<TurAgentChatExecutor.ChatResponse> assistantConversationStreaming(TurGenAiContext context, TurAIAgent agent, TurLLMInstance llmInstance, List<TurSNGenAi.ConversationMessage> history, Map<String, List<String>> filters)
      Streaming conversational variant that delegates LLM execution and tool calling to TurAgentChatExecutor, while keeping the SN-specific RAG retrieval here. The retrieved chunks are injected into the system prompt before the executor runs, so the agent's tools (native + MCP) are also available to the LLM during the same call.
      Since:
      2026.2.4

    • addDocumentToContext

      public void addDocumentToContext(TurSNSite turSNSite, Locale locale, TurGenAiContext context, Map<String,Object> doc)
      Indexes a document with a TurGenAiContext that was already built by the caller — skips the per-doc resolveCollectionName and turGenAiContextFactory.build round-trips. Used by the parallel reindex flow which shares a single context across all documents of a locale, since the context is locale-bound but doc-independent.

      Must only be called when context.isEnabled() is already verified (the public addDocument(TurSNSite, Locale, Map) still does the validation when no pre-built context is available).

      Since:
      2026.2.4
